guide.relicweave.mob.reliquary_sentinel: Wait out its raised shield, then strike while it is Exposed. Hits from behind ignore the guard.
guide.relicweave.mob.scriptbound_scribe: Close the distance while it casts; it is helpless and takes extra damage during Recovery.
guide.relicweave.mob.gilded_husk: Hit it from the side or behind, and land one big blow to crack its armor.
guide.relicweave.mob.mirebound_cantor: Hit it hard to break its chant, and stay quiet in the Hushfen or it calls its allies.
guide.relicweave.mob.oathbreaker_knight: Read the stance: attack behind its Guard, sidestep the Sweep ring and the Lunge line.
guide.relicweave.mob.vestige_drifter: Harmless unless hurt. Give it an Inscribed Page to hear a fragment of lore.
guide.relicweave.mob.rift_archer: Break line of sight when the aim line appears, then keep moving; arrows lead you.
guide.relicweave.mob.echo_weaver: Decoy bolts are harmless; leave the 5 block pulse ring when notes gather around it.
subtitles.relicweave.entity.oathbreaker_: Oathbreaker Knight winds up a sweep
Echo Weaver gathers a sonic pulse
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.0: The Crown was never a place. It was a promise made by nine hands.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.1: Pages burn, but the Archive remembers what was written on them.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.2: The Cycle does not turn for us. We simply learned to count its turning.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.3: Sentinels kept the oath long after they forgot whom it was sworn to.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.4: The fen is quiet because the fen is listening.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.5: Gold stays when the flesh does not. Ask the husks.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.6: A glyph is a held breath. Read it gently.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.7: When the sky falls in the caldera, walk toward the light that is not falling.
message.relicweave.drifter.silent: The drifter has said all it will say for now.
